Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1413
Claimant:
David Anderson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-10-12
Claim opened after the insured reported a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The driver is named on the
policy, and the claimant's vehicle was the one struck from behind.
2024-11-16
Police report received and reviewed. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact, and it matches
the account given by the insured.
2024-11-26
Photos from the scene and the repair shop show the rear bumper damage and the point of contact. They confirm
some of the details reported, but there are no independent witnesses to the impact itself.
2024-12-06
Vehicle inspection completed. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or repair records, and
nothing suggests the damage occurred before the coverage period began.
2025-02-01
Claimant's representing attorney contacted the desk and advised that the claimant has neck and upper back pain
consistent with whiplash. Medical records requested.
2025-02-04
Medical records reviewed. The reported injury is plausible for a collision of this type, and no earlier injury to the same
body area is known from the records received so far.
2025-03-17
The claimant has told the same account of the collision in every conversation with the adjuster and the attorney, with
no material changes in the sequence of events.
2025-03-20
Repair estimate reviewed. Some of the listed damage appears to be in areas that may not have been affected by this
impact, so it is not clear yet whether all of the damage came from this collision. Requested a supplemental inspection.
2025-04-20
Treatment records show a usual course of care, with treatment frequency reducing as the claimant's symptoms
improved. Treating provider notes indicate steady progress.
2025-04-27
File remains open pending the supplemetnal inspection results and final treatment records. Next review scheduled
once those documents are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
